title: Australian Zesty Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make rice bowl dish with a hint of Australian spices. This dish is a perfect combination of zesty and silky textures.

ingredients.name: Sautéed vegetables (silky texture)
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and green beans

instructions: Heat Australian olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sautéed vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in Australian bush tomatoes and cook for an additional minute.
Add cooked Australian zesty rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped cilantro.
